def find_Parity(n):
    """
    Returns True if n is odd, False otherwise (i.e., even).
    
    Examples:
        find_Parity(12) -> False  # 12 is even
        find_Parity(7)   -> True   # 7 is odd
    """
    return n % 2 != 0

```python
def find_Parity(n):
    """
    Returns True if n is odd, False otherwise (i.e., even).
    
    Examples:
        find_Parity(12) -> False  # 12 is even
        find_Parity(7)   -> True   # 7 is odd
    """
    return n % 2 != 0


# Test as given in the prompt
assert find_Parity(12) == False, "Expected False for input 12"

# Additional quick checks (optional but helpful):
print(find_Parity(1))   # True
print(find_Parity(-3))  # True
